messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: P0 page for ZenithCorp VPC app-proxy — elevated streaming connection failures and client retry amplification. See runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/app-gateway-streaming

Raj: seeing ~42% of SSE/ws connections drop with 502/504 on the enterprise gateway 10:03 UTC. error-rate spike started ~09:55. stack shows proxy upstream timeouts.

Maia: copying initial metrics — connection duration distribution shifted left, many early resets. Can we hold traffic to a more conservative path? Suggest temporary routing to zenith-dedicated-pool and enable gateway-side retry-window dedupe.

Luke: I can push a config to edge to clamp client retries to 3 with exponential backoff and add jitter. Preparing a one-line rollout:
```yaml
- name: clamp-retries
  match: tenant:zenithcorp
  action: set_retry_policy(max_attempts:3, base_delay_ms:200, max_delay_ms:2000, jitter:true)
```
Doing canary to 5% now.

Sofia: pinging Zenith Ops for confirmation and to ask about any recent deploys on their side. @Zenith Ops can you confirm if you rolled anything around 03:10 UTC? Also sending customer-facing note template.

Zenith Ops: confirmed — we deployed a proxy-side change at 03:08 that increased client retry behavior (per our new client lib). We're rolling that back now. Noted increased 429 throttles from our side; will coordinate logs in 10m.

Raj: partial mitigations pushed: clamp-retries canary in prod at 5% (edge). Also added temporary route: tenant=zenithcorp -> zenith-dedicated-pool (warm nodes) for 20m. Watching error-rate.

infra-bot: Canary rollout started by Luke (rollout-id: r-2026-03-17-0830). Observability feedback: 5xx rate for zenith decreased from 42% -> 18% within 3m of route change.

Maia: good signal. Next step: enable SSE fallback to long-poll for tenants showing >20% streaming reset rate. I can toggle that at the gateway feature flag. Will coordinate with CS for customer impact messaging.

Sofia: drafting customer update: "We're mitigating streaming instability by throttling retries at the edge and routing you to a dedicated pool while you roll back the client change. We'll confirm when fully stable." Sending to Zenith for approval.

Zenith Ops: approved. We'll keep rollback in flight and share logs. Thanks for the quick mitigation.

Raj: handing off to Maia for 1hr follow-up. I'll stay on the incident until full stability or if error-rate bounces back >25%. Maia, please escalate to Dedicated Escalation if latency/5xx doesn't stabilize within 30m.

Maia: ack, taking ownership. Turning on SSE->long-poll fallback for tenant in 2m and extending keepalive to 30s at gateway. Noting: add post-incident action to enforce retry-window dedupe at customer SDK level. :white_check_mark: 

infra-bot: Update: keepalive change rolled (cfg-id: cfg-keepalive-3925). Error-rate now 7% and stable for 10m. Closing on-call handoff.

Raj: thanks team — creating postmortem stub and scheduling a cross-team sync with Zenith engineering to discuss SDK retry patterns and long-term routing configs.

Zenith Ops: appreciate it — we'll join the postmortem and share client telemetry.
